title: 第1章 开局被下毒害死第2章 还得筒子来救场
slug: 开局六连抽创建万古帝朝
content_zh:
乾坤大陆，
大萧皇朝，
都城萧京犹如一颗璀璨的明珠或者是巨龙一般，在这片广袤的土地上闪耀着光芒。
在其的内城区繁华地段的一隅，一座看似古朴典雅却又不失奢华的府邸，静静地伫立着，与周围那些豪华宏伟的建筑相比，显得有些格格不入。
门匾上那“凡王府”三个笔走龙蛇的金灿灿大字，笔走龙蛇，直插云霄，彰显出府邸的非凡气势。
府邸中一间卧室的大床上，躺着一个身着紫金色蟒龙袍的少年，他宛如沉睡的雄狮一般，毫无生机。
在门外，一个扎着马尾辫的小姑娘如同热锅上的蚂蚁，焦急地守候着，时间已经过去了好几个时辰。
蓦然，身披紫金色蟒龙袍的少年如同一道闪电般从床上弹了起来。
他的目光如鹰隼般扫视着这个陌生的房间，整个房间的设计和装饰古色古香、高贵典雅，宛如一座典雅的类似古代的宫殿。
突然，他的脑袋像是被千万根钢针同时刺穿一般，疼痛难忍，一头栽倒在豪华舒适的大床上。
一股股不属于他的记忆如汹涌澎湃的潮水一般，不断涌入他的脑海之中，
仿佛似是要将他的大脑淹没。
大约过了半个多小时，
一切恢复正常后，
他终于接受完了这具身体的几乎所有记忆和信息。
心里喃喃自语道，“我竟然穿越了！”
他清晰地记得自己刚才还在蓝色水星，华国一家鹅鹅游戏公司总部的科技部办公室里加班，他是公司里一名过着“996”生活的基层开发人员，如同一只被生活鞭笞的社畜。
由于公司即将发布《三国争霸》的游戏，他已经连续在公司奋战了七个昼夜。
为了缓解疲劳，他冲了一杯香飘飘咖啡，当他端着咖啡返回自己的工位时，或许太过劳累，一个没有站稳，昏倒了。
........

“再次醒来时，他发现自己莫名其妙地来到了这个名为乾坤大陆的世界，而他的名字也恰好叫萧凡，和他穿越前的名字一模一样。”
“通过继承原身的记忆，他了解到这个世界类似于他前世所在的龙国的古代封建王朝，他的身份竟然是大萧皇朝的六皇子。”
然而，
这个陌生的异世界中也存在着许多与前世截然不同的地方，
其中最为引人注目的便是这里有一种人人向往的职业——武者。
他们宛如这个异世界的神明，主宰着这里的一切。
一般的低阶武者就如同猛虎下山，可以轻而易举地对付数个，甚至数十个普通人。
中高阶武道强者更是如同战神附体，可以以一当千，甚至同时对付成千上万个普通人，劈山断海也不在话下。
而最顶级的巅峰强者更是如同九天之上的神只，可以说一人镇压一国，也毫不夸张。
这也使得在这个以武为尊的异世界中，
涌现出了各种如繁星般璀璨的王朝、皇朝、宗门、帮派、世家等。
呈现出一幅中王朝、皇朝争霸、宗门世家林立，战乱与战争此起彼伏的混乱局面。
.......
萧凡心里不禁暗自思忖，“前世，他也曾涉猎过一些网文小说，权当消遣那闲暇时光。从原身的记忆来看，他所抵达的这个异世界，充其量不过是一个类似高武的世界罢了。”
罢了！暂且不去想这些了。
还是先弄清楚自己为何会稀里糊涂地穿越到一位皇子身上吧！
突然，他只觉浑身酸软无力，面色苍白如纸，一口黑色脓血如决堤的洪水般喷涌而出，落在床边的痰罐中。
content_en:
Qiankun Continent,
Great Xiao Dynasty,
The capital city of Xiao Jing is like a bright pearl or a giant dragon, shining brightly in this vast land.
In a corner of the bustling inner city, a seemingly simple and elegant yet luxurious mansion stands quietly, looking a little out of place compared to the luxurious and magnificent buildings around it.
On the door plaque, the three golden characters "Fanwangfu" with a dragon and a snake in the strokes of a pen, reaching straight into the sky, demonstrate the extraordinary momentum of the mansion.
On a big bed in a bedroom in the mansion, there lay a young man dressed in a purple-gold python dragon robe. He was like a sleeping lion, lifeless.
Outside the door, a little girl with a ponytail was waiting anxiously like an ant on a hot pot. Several hours had passed.
Suddenly, the young man wearing a purple-gold python dragon robe jumped up from the bed like a bolt of lightning.
His eyes scanned this unfamiliar room like a hawk. The design and decoration of the entire room were antique, noble and elegant, like an elegant palace similar to ancient times.
Suddenly, his head felt like it was pierced by thousands of steel needles at the same time. The pain was unbearable, and he fell down on the luxurious and comfortable big bed.
Memories that did not belong to him were pouring into his mind like a surging tide.
It seemed as if it was going to overwhelm his brain.
About half an hour later,
After everything returns to normal,
He finally accepted almost all the memories and information from this body.
I muttered to myself, "I actually traveled through time!"
He clearly remembered that he had just been working overtime in the science and technology office of Blue Mercury, a Goose game company headquarters in China. He was a grassroots developer in the company who lived a "996" life, like a social animal being whipped by life.
Since the company is about to release the game "Three Kingdoms", he has been working hard at the company for seven consecutive days and nights.
In order to relieve his fatigue, he brewed a cup of fragrant coffee. When he returned to his work station with the coffee, he was probably too tired and lost his balance and passed out.
........
"When he woke up again, he found that he had inexplicably arrived in this world called Qiankun Continent, and his name happened to be Xiao Fan, which was exactly the same as his name before traveling."
"By inheriting the memory of his original body, he learned that this world is similar to the ancient feudal dynasty of the Dragon Kingdom where he lived in his previous life. His identity is actually the sixth prince of the Great Xiao Dynasty."
However,
There are also many places in this strange world that are completely different from the previous life.
The most eye-catching thing is that there is a profession that everyone yearns for - warrior.
They are like gods from this other world, dominating everything here.
The average low-level warrior is like a tiger descending from the mountain, and can easily deal with several, or even dozens of ordinary people.
Intermediate and high-level martial arts masters are like gods of war. They can fight one against a thousand, or even deal with tens of thousands of ordinary people at the same time, breaking mountains and seas.
The top peak experts are like gods above the nine heavens. It is no exaggeration to say that one person can suppress an entire country.
This also makes it possible that in this different world where martial arts is respected,
Various dynasties, dynasties, sects, gangs, aristocratic families, etc. have emerged as bright as stars.
It presents a chaotic situation of Chinese dynasties, dynasties competing for hegemony, numerous sects and families, and wars and wars one after another.
.......
Xiao Fan couldn't help but think to himself, "In his previous life, he also dabbled in some online novels, just to amuse his spare time. Judging from the original memory, the different world he arrived in was, at best, a world similar to Gaowu."
That’s it! Let’s not think about this for now.
It’s better to figure out why you time-traveled into a prince in a daze first!
Suddenly, he felt sore all overHe was weak, his face was as pale as paper, and a mouthful of black pus and blood spurted out like a bursting flood, falling into the spit jar beside the bed.
